slides.headline: Anthropic just landed the AI world's most wanted hire
slides.body: Karpathy is in. And the pretraining race just shifted.

slides.headline: Pretraining is the moonshot nobody talks about
slides.body: Everyone is racing to build better AI products on top of existing models. The real leverage — and the real moat — sits one layer down: in pretraining, the phase that determines what a model fundamentally knows and can do. Getting pretraining right is harder, slower, and more expensive than any other part of AI development. It is also the ground where frontier models are actually won or lost.

slides.headline: Karpathy will lead pretraining research at Anthropic
slides.body: Andrej Karpathy — OpenAI co-founder, former head of Tesla Autopilot AI, author of the most-watched AI education content on YouTube — confirmed on May 19 that he has joined Anthropic to build and lead a pretraining research team. The stated goal: use Claude itself as a tool to accelerate the research loop. Anthropic confirmed the hire the same day. Karpathy had been independent since leaving OpenAI in 2023.
FRONTIER LABS KARPATHY HAS NOW SHAPED

slides.headline: This changes Anthropic's research credibility overnight
slides.body: Karpathy is not just famous — he is technically respected in a way few AI figures are across the entire research community. His presence signals that Anthropic is building for the long game on model fundamentals, not just shipping products. For enterprise buyers evaluating which lab's models to trust with critical workloads, the quality of the pretraining team is a proxy for how good the next generation of models will be.

slides.headline: The real bet is using Claude to train better Claudes
slides.body: The framing of 'using Claude to accelerate pretraining research' is the quietly radical part of this announcement. It describes a recursive improvement loop — AI-assisted research feeding back into better base models — which is the exact mechanism leading labs are racing to operationalize. Karpathy building that system at Anthropic, with the credibility to attract the researchers who can execute it, is a structural advantage that won't show up in any benchmark for 12 to 18 months.

items.body: Talent at the model-foundation layer predicts frontier capability 1-2 years out.

items.body: Karpathy's influence will show up in Claude's fundamental reasoning before it shows up in features.
